discovery.failedBody: Meta's Ad Library didn't answer. Nothing was charged. Try again in a few minutes.

picked.title: We picked {n, plural, one {# competitor} other {# competitors}} for you
picked.body: Direct competitors come first; an adjacent niche only fills a spot when there aren't enough. Remove any that isn't yours and the next one in reserve takes its place.

comp.winners: {n, plural, one {# likely winner} other {# likely winners}}
comp.importing: Bringing their ads. The count shows at least what we've seen so far.
comp.capPaused: Weekly checks paused: this month's research budget is used up.

dismiss.title: Remove {name}?
dismiss.body: It leaves the feed and doesn't come back in a new search.
dismiss.reserveYes: The next one in reserve takes its spot.
dismiss.reserveNo: There's nobody in reserve, so the spot stays open until the next search.
dismiss.savedStay: Ads you saved from it stay in Saved.

removed.title: Removed competitors
removed.body: They don't come back in new searches. Undo brings one back if there's a free spot.
removed.limit: All {max} spots are taken. Remove someone first to bring {name} back.

radar.summary: {total, plural, one {# ad} other {# ads}} · {winners, plural, one {# likely winner} other {# likely winners}}

card.noVideo: This ad has no video to use
card.readOnly: Only the agency can use ads

why.title: Why “likely winner”
why.both: Running {days} days with {versions} versions live. Meta doesn't show competitors' spend; brands rarely keep a losing ad on for a month.
why.days: Running {days} days. Meta doesn't show competitors' spend; brands rarely keep a losing ad on for a month.
why.versions: {versions} versions of this ad are live. Brands make more versions of what's working.

detail.versionsLine: {n} versions running · same ad, different text
detail.loadingVideo: Getting the video from Meta, about 30 seconds. You can close this.
detail.expired: Meta's link to this video expired. Load it again to watch or use it.
detail.usedIn: Used in {n, plural, one {# batch} other {# batches}}
detail.notFound: This ad isn't in your radar anymore.

empty.nomatchBody: Try “Any time” or “All formats”. Competitors with few ads rarely have something running 90+ days.
empty.savedBody: Tap the bookmark on any ad to keep it here. Saved ads also show up in Templates, in the step where you pick the ad.
empty.noAdsBody: We check every week, and they'll show up here when they start again.
empty.importing: Bringing {name}'s ads… they show up here in a moment.

error.compFail: Meta's Ad Library didn't answer for {name}.
error.compFailBody: Last good check was {ago}. We'll try again soon; the other competitors are up to date.

cap.title: This month's research budget is used up
cap.body: New searches and refreshes are paused until next month. The ads you already have stay here.

quota.title: Meta's Ad Library is at its limit
quota.body: New searches and refreshes come back on {date}. Everything already here keeps working.

off.title: Ad Radar is coming soon
off.body: Soon you'll see your competitors' ads here, sorted by how long they've been running.

radar.readOnly: You can look at the ads. The agency picks which ones to use.

toast.saved: Saved · also in Templates › Saved ads
toast.cap: This month's research budget is used up.

champion.note: From a competitor ad we keep the structure: the hook, the pacing, the format. Your offer, product, voice and claims come from your Brain. Their logo, product shots and claims don't come along.
champion.reading: We read this ad on first use · about 1 min, free. You can pick templates now.
champion.read: Read. Every card below says if it fits this ad.

r1.title: This video belongs to a competitor
r1.body: Edit templates put the competitor's own footage in your ad. If they report it, Meta can take your ad down and flag your ad account. Safer: keep only the structure with an AI template, or film your own version.

adStep.emptyBody: Save competitor ads in Ad Radar and they show up here.
adStep.line: {days, plural, one {# day running} other {# days running}}

top.exportTip: Re-render this piece with your edits. No new generation, no credits.
top.exportBlocked: Fix the red checks to export

banner.clientBody: Only the team can edit and export it.
banner.readOnlyBody: It opens read-only so the version in your ads stays the same.
banner.conflictBody: Your last change was not saved. Load their version to keep editing; there is no merge.
banner.exportingBody: re-rendering with your edits. No new generation. You can leave; it keeps going.
banner.blockedBody: A red check or an unconfirmed number appeared on the server. Fix it and export again.
banner.doneBody: The piece now carries the “Edited” badge and its code ends in -ED. 4:5 and 1:1 re-render when you ask for them (free).
banner.invalidBody: It breaks a rule of this template. Undo it or change it again.

fail.caption: The caption check failed after the render.
fail.text: The text check failed after the render.
fail.kept: The piece was not replaced; the previous version stays.

cover.title: Opening the editor
cover.body: Loading a light copy of your video so dragging stays smooth. The export uses the full-quality file.
cover.proxy: Preparing the 540p preview copy · about {s} s

pill.caption: Burned caption clear
pill.noPicture: No picture of you: face and caption rules don't apply

issue.caption_cut: The burned caption is cut off
issue.face_cut: The face is cut off by the video frame
issue.text_overflow: {layer}: the text doesn't fit the box
issue.invented_number: “{n}” isn't in the transcript or the Brain
issue.low_contrast: {layer}: low contrast between text and background

fix.caption_covered: Move it off the red area, or turn on guides to see it.
fix.face_covered: Keep at least 90% of the face clear.
fix.caption_cut: Zoom out or use Auto reframe.
fix.face_cut: Zoom out or use Auto reframe.
fix.text_overflow: Make the box bigger or the text shorter.
fix.low_contrast: Pick a text or background color with more contrast.

number.memo: “{n}” isn't in what was said or in the Brain. Numbers have to come from the video or the Brain. Export waits until you confirm.

layers.title: Layers
layers.hint: Click a layer or the canvas. Arrow keys move the selected layer (Shift = 10 px). Double-click your video to reframe it.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.hint: Click a lane to jump there. Timed lines come in a later step.
timeline.hintTrim: Click a lane to jump there. Drag the ends of your video's bar to trim it. The hatched part is cut.

tpl.positionHint: Fine-tune any layer by dragging it, or in the Layer tab.
tpl.formatHint: Switching format re-fits the layout. Text, colors and fonts stay. 4:5 and 1:1 are free.
tpl.schema: How this panel was built: the controls this template declares
tpl.later: This control comes in a later step.

content.sub: Every line is editable. Each line keeps where it came from.
content.subTimed: Every line is editable. The time is where it shows in the video; click it to jump there. Each line keeps where it came from.
content.none: This template has no text to edit.

exportReason.nothing_to_export: Nothing changed since the last export.
exportReason.export_running: An export of this piece is already running.
exportReason.render_running: This piece is rendering. Try again when it finishes.
exportReason.not_saved: Your last edit isn't saved yet. Wait for “Saved” and export again.

reframe.hint: Drag to move · scroll or corner to zoom · Esc to finish
reframe.autoOn: Auto reframe is on: face and burned caption stay in view.
reframe.autoOff: Set by you. Auto reframe brings back the face and the burned caption.

trim.title: Trim
trim.sub: start and end of your video
trim.output: Output {s} s. Lines outside the trim are hidden, not deleted.

lyr.noneBody: Click anything on the canvas or pick it from the list. Every layer of this template can be selected: text, boxes and your video.
lyr.burnedBody: It is part of the pixels of your video, so it can't be moved or edited here. The editor protects it instead: nothing may cover it.
lyr.burnedHow: To change these words, upload the version of your video without captions and turn on our captions.
lyr.linesBody: The items are in Template › Content, each with where it came from.
lyr.brollNext: Swapping the second video comes in a later step.
lyr.uniformHint: This template scales the box's content evenly: width and height change together.
lyr.fixed: This layer stays where the template placed it.
lyr.videoFixed: This layer fills the canvas in this template.
lyr.videoFixedReframe: This layer fills the canvas in this template. You can still reframe it.
